assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup, realistic miniature sewing asset for an artist portfolio's play button. An isolated single small, ROUND, empty piece of warm ivory off-white fine cotton linen (#fff7e7), photographed entirely flat, straight on from directly above. Centered circle on a square transparent canvas, same diameter horizontally and vertically, fills ~85% of the square. The circle is solid light ivory fabric all the way across. Fine subtle natural weave, a neatly cut handmade circular edge with minor fiber texture. About 7% in from its edge, sew ONE concentric ring of roughly 22 small tangential running stitches of fine two-ply clear azure blue (#2086f9) embroidery thread. Each dash is naturally separated by a small ivory gap. Stitch lengths about twice their visible thickness, fine and readable at 56px display size. Yarn has a soft fiber sheen and slightly irregular tension. The stitches run ALONG the circumference, not perpendicular. Restrained, flat, clean, delicate; no additional rings, no outlines, no merrowed border, no button holes, no scallops, no text, no symbols or illustrations, no knots or loose ends. Leave the substantial flat ivory disk center completely EMPTY and opaque, ready to put a separate existing triangle on top later. Outside the circle: true transparent alpha, no surrounding square, no tabletop, no cast shadow. Color neutral soft lighting.
